root: ^It appears to be a corroded metal birdcage, door missing, bars bent; signs of long-term exposure to moisture and decay.
^Dust drifts in sunlit beams across a quiet living room. A PET BIRD chirps gently inside the cage as a RADIO crackles nearby.
^Radio Announcer (O.S.): —rising tensions across borders, officials urge evacuation—
^The bird hops anxiously on its perch. A HAND appears, trembling, unlatches the cage. The bird hesitates, then flutters out the open window.
^Radio Announcer (O.S.): We repeat—this is not a drill—
^A blinding white light blooms in the distance. Curtains ripple. The bird vanishes into the sky just before the world goes silent.
